fix.meaning: n.新闻界，记者；报刊；出版社
fix.ex_en: The power of the press is very great.
fix.ex_zh: 新闻界的力量非常大。

fix.ex_en: Please read the handout carefully.
fix.ex_zh: 请仔细阅读这份讲义。

fix.ex_en: Listening to music is the favourite pastime of many people all over the world.
fix.ex_zh: 听音乐是全世界许多人最喜爱的消遣。

fix.meaning: （=program）n.节目；方案；（演出或活动的）程序 v.为（系统）设定程序；计划
fix.ex_en: There was an interesting programme on TV yesterday.
fix.ex_zh: 昨天有个很有趣的电视节目。

fix.ex_en: The magician thrilled his audienee with his magic.
fix.ex_zh: 魔术师用他的魔术使观众们激动万分。

fix.ex_en: This painting is invaluable.
fix.ex_zh: 这幅画是非常珍贵的。

fix.ex_en: The drum is one of the oldest musical instruments.
fix.ex_zh: 鼓是最古老的乐器之一。

fix.ex_en: The violin is not quite in tune with the piano.
fix.ex_zh: 小提琴跟钢琴的调子不太和谐。

fix.ex_en: A wealthy patron has promised to send him to study overseas.
fix.ex_zh: 一个富有的赞助人答应要送他出国留学。

fix.ex_en: The stadium has been fitted with seating for 100,000 spectators.
fix.ex_zh: 这个体育场配备了10万个观众座席。

fix.meaning: v.伸开四肢坐着（或躺着）；延伸，蔓延n.（城市）杂乱无序扩展的地区
fix.ex_en: He sprawled on the sofa.
fix.ex_zh: 他手脚摊开，躺在沙发上。

fix.ex_en: Hundreds of private golf clubs took part in a recent study.
fix.ex_zh: 数百家私人高尔夫俱乐部参与了最近的研究。

fix.ex_en: The home side rubbed in their superiority with a further goal.
fix.ex_zh: 主队再进一球，从而奠定了优势。

fix.ex_en: She tumbled on the slick, damp ground.
fix.ex_zh: 她在这又滑又湿的地上摔倒了。

fix.ex_en: Diving is a part of this expedition.
fix.ex_zh: 潜水是这次探险活动的一部分。

fix.ex_en: The cat crouched ready to spring.
fix.ex_zh: 那只猫俯身准备起跳。

fix.ex_en: The ball hit the wall and bounced off it.
fix.ex_zh: 球打在墙上又反弹开。

fix.ex_en: Let's eat our picnic by the waterfall.
fix.ex_zh: 咱们在瀑布旁吃野餐吧。

fix.meaning: n.赛跑，速度竞赛；人种，种族
fix.ex_en: The horse is racing against five others.
fix.ex_zh: 这匹马正在和其他五匹马比赛。

fix.ex_en: He bent his walking cHrection toward me.
fix.ex_zh: 他转身向我走来。
fix.notes: bend over backwards to do sth.竭尽全力去做某事

add.ex_en: No journalist was bold eno ugh to challe nge the Prime Minister.
add.ex_zh: 没有一个记者大胆到敢挑战首相。

add.ex_en: We were paid to leaflet advertisements in the shopping mall.
add.ex_zh: 有人雇我们在购物中心发放广告传单。

add.ex_en: The smooth contour of the sculpture is wonderful.
add.ex_zh: 这座雕塑流畅的轮廓线真是太美了。

add.meaning: n.体育活动；（=gymnasium）健身房，体育馆
add.ex_en: Both able-bodied and disabled people can use this gym.
add.ex_zh: 健全人士和残障人士都可使用这家健身房。

add.meaning: n.马拉松赛跑；马拉松式的活动
add.ex_en: Gallard completed the marathon in less than three hours.
add.ex_zh: 加勒德在不到三个小时的时间里就跑完了马拉松。
